label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): counterexample: the same construct wrapped in construct-irrelevant barriers, plus unlabeled student work.

objectives.text: Calculate markup, contribution margin and weekly gross profit for store items with spreadsheet formulas built from cell references.
objectives.construct: applying markup and gross profit calculations in a spreadsheet

tasks.prompt: Utilizing the proprietary enterprise spreadsheet application, operationalize comprehensive profitability calculations, incorporating differentiated markup methodologies, contribution-margin considerations and organizational inventory-valuation conventions. Subsequently, characterize the consequential implications of hypothetical pricing modifications within the remaining examination interval.

rubric.scoring_rationale: Same criterion as the main unit.

levels.descriptor: Beginning: values typed in, or calculation wrong
Developing: correct method on some items, one error in references or logic
Proficient: correct results from cell references or queries, with a one-sentence explanation
Advanced: proficient, and the model updates correctly when an input changes, with the reason stated
